servicesPage.intro: At Arrow Electrical Contractors, we offer a full range of electrical services for residential and commercial clients in Dallas. Our licensed electricians deliver safe, reliable, and efficient solutions tailored to your needs.

services.title: Residential Wiring & Rewiring
services.shortDescription: Safe, code-compliant wiring for new homes or upgrades.
services.longDescription: From new construction to old home rewiring, we ensure your electrical system is safe, efficient, and up to code. Our team handles everything from outlets to full panel upgrades.
benefits: Enhanced safety and reduced fire risk

process.title: Inspection
process.description: We assess your current wiring and discuss your needs.

process.title: Plan & Quote
process.description: We provide a detailed plan and transparent estimate.

process.title: Installation
process.description: Our electricians complete the work efficiently and cleanly.

faqs.question: How long does a full rewiring take?
faqs.answer: A typical home rewiring takes 3-7 days depending on size and complexity.

faqs.question: Do I need a permit for rewiring?
faqs.answer: Yes, we handle all permits and inspections to ensure code compliance.

services.title: Panel Upgrades & Repairs
services.shortDescription: Upgrade your electrical panel for safety and capacity.
services.longDescription: Older panels can be a fire hazard and limit your home's electrical capacity. We upgrade to modern, safe panels that handle today's demands.

process.title: Assessment
process.description: We evaluate your current panel and load requirements.

process.title: Selection
process.description: We recommend the best panel for your needs and budget.

process.title: Installation
process.description: We safely install and test the new panel.

faqs.question: How do I know if I need a panel upgrade?
faqs.answer: Signs include flickering lights, frequent breaker trips, or using many high-wattage appliances.

faqs.question: Is panel upgrade dangerous?
faqs.answer: Only if done improperly. Our licensed electricians follow strict safety protocols.

services.title: Lighting Installation & Design
services.shortDescription: Beautiful, energy-efficient lighting for any space.
services.longDescription: Enhance your home or business with custom lighting solutions. From indoor ambiance to outdoor security lighting, we design and install fixtures that save energy and look great.
benefits: Lower energy bills with LED options
Custom designs to fit your style

process.title: Consultation
process.description: We discuss your vision and assess the space.

process.title: Design
process.description: We create a lighting plan with fixture selection.

process.title: Installation
process.description: We professionally install and test all lighting.

faqs.question: Can you install outdoor lighting?
faqs.answer: Yes, we specialize in outdoor lighting including landscape, security, and patio.

faqs.question: What type of bulbs are most efficient?
faqs.answer: LED bulbs are the most energy-efficient and long-lasting. We recommend them for most applications.

services.title: Emergency Electrical Repairs
services.shortDescription: 24/7 emergency service for urgent electrical issues.
services.longDescription: Electrical emergencies can happen anytime. Our team is on call 24/7 to handle power outages, sparking outlets, or other dangerous situations. We arrive quickly and resolve the issue safely.

process.title: Call
process.description: Contact us anytime, and we'll dispatch a team immediately.

process.title: Diagnose
process.description: We quickly identify the problem and explain the solution.

process.title: Repair
process.description: We fix the issue safely and restore power.

faqs.question: What qualifies as an electrical emergency?
faqs.answer: Any situation that poses a safety risk, such as exposed wires, sparking outlets, or total power loss.

faqs.question: Do you charge extra for emergency calls?
faqs.answer: We have a standard emergency service fee, but we'll provide the cost upfront before any work begins.

about.headline: Your Trusted Dallas Electrician
about.mission: To provide safe, reliable, and affordable electrical services to the Dallas community with integrity and professionalism.
story: Arrow Electrical Contractors, LLC was founded with a simple mission: deliver exceptional electrical work with a focus on safety and customer satisfaction. Over the years, we've grown from a small operation to a trusted name in Dallas, serving hundreds of homes and businesses.

Our team of licensed electricians brings years of experience to every project, big or small. We pride ourselves on clear communication, upfront pricing, and a commitment to doing the job right the first time. Whether it's a simple repair or a complex installation, we treat every job with the same level of care.
